_comment: Tunables for the utilization-sharing RSI loop's capacity forecast (rsi_util_capacity.py). efficiency_multiplier is the lab-capability lever: bump it above 1.0 when a lab capability lands that raises effective throughput (e.g. MLX-LM ~1.3x, a faster quant, a smaller model that meets quality) — that raises effective capacity and pushes the pre-order date right, so capability gains defer capex.
efficiency_note: 1.0 baseline; bump when a lab capability lands (e.g. MLX-LM ~1.3x, new quant).
